title: Convenient Storage
description: A mod that stores almost everything in just a single item.
body:
Convenient Storage is a lightweight mod that only added an item: Storage Tablet.

# NOTICE

*   Don't use __Inventory Profiles Next__ and __Inventory Essentials__, they conflicts with this mod.
*   It is recommended to use [Inventory Sorter](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/inventory-sorter) and [Mouse Tweaks](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mouse-tweaks).
*   Use [this mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/convenient-interface) to allow your storage to interact with blocks, which also enables energy storage.

# UTILITIES

*   **Basic Usage**: Storing almost infinity items, fluids, experience._(Capped at 9223372036854775807)_
*   **Enchantment**: Stores enchantments, use /gamerule limitedEnchantmentLevels false to disable the limit of enchantment withdrawed.
*   **Waypoint**: Stores waypoints anywhere you come and use casually anytime.
*   **Entity**: Stores when rightclick on an entity, you can attack or resummon them or make them to spawn eggs in storage.
*   **Interact**: Collecting fluid from level like a bucket, pouring fluid into level like a filled bucket while "Selected Fluid" is not empty.
*   **Auto Pick**: Configure items automatically store into storage when picked up inside tablet.
*   **Fluid Auto Pick**: Pick up fluid blocks within your reach automatically while enabled and holding tablet.
*   **Quick Loot**: Right click on loot chests to pick up loots directly.
*   **Craft**: Built in a crafting table in Storage Tablet's menu, supporting complex operations.
*   **Smelt**: Smelt items with "heat\_source" instead of fuel in Storage Tablet's menu.
*   **Forge**: Inner anvil that never causes "Too Expensive"!
*   **Smith**: Inner smithing table!
*   **Cut**: Inner composite cutter which means you can also cut woods and stones inside tablet, wood-cutting recipes can be configured with datapack.
*   **Brew**: Inner brewing stand which can brew continuously.
*   **Enchant**: Built in Enchanting Table.
*   **Search**: Start with c to search s. '@':Mod name; '#':Tag; ':':Item ID.
*   **Team Storage**: Use /storage to store items with other players.
*   **Energy**: Storing infinity energy if energy storage is enabled.

# SPECIAL

We use torches, campfires and magma blocks as heat source for smelting.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1309336/description_eb62e870-5ab1-437a-a2e0-8db151d33c63.png)

This is configurable by datapack.

# ADDITIONAL

Once you crafted a Storage Tablet, you can only use Item Storage and Crafting Utility initially.

Use according recipes to upgrade your tablet with more Storages and Utilities.

If you disliked upgrading tablet frequently, use command "/gamerule restrictedTabletTabs false" to disable this.

Then you can use all Storages and Utilities regardless of whether it was upgraded.
